verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no JetBrains plugin and no in-IDE interactive diff view for Aider. The closest feature is --watch-files, which picks up AI comments saved in any editor. That is an adjacent, editor-agnostic mechanism: it does not show diffs in the IDE or let you share a selected code range as context, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
